cases.customer_question: What test-plan information should be provided when a customer performs Bluetooth testing using loaned reference equipment?
cases.actual_issue: A decision was needed regarding whether an internal test plan containing report-specific information should be provided to a customer performing self-testing.
cases.plain_english_explanation: Internal test plans can contain information intended only for report preparation or internal workflows. When supporting customer-run testing, only the information necessary for executing the tests should be shared. Customer-facing documents should be simplified appropriately.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant determined that the original test plan contained report-related information that was unnecessary for customer self-testing. A customer-facing version with the unnecessary report information removed was prepared and designated for distribution instead of the original internal document.
cases.decision_logic: Customer-provided testing documentation should contain only the information needed to execute the testing activity. Internal reporting content should be removed when it is not required for the customer's purpose.
cases.final_recommendation: Create a customer-facing version of the test plan that excludes internal report-generation content and distribute only the information required to perform the testing.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Customers may receive unnecessary internal information, increasing document-control complexity and creating confusion about which information is required for testing.
